name: Dark Magenta
lede: Dark magenta is an X11 web color, a deep purple-pink that the ISCC-NBS system had already indexed in 1955.

sections.title: A web color, an older block
sections.body:
Paterson lists *DarkMagenta* as one of the colors of the X11 set, with the hex code #8B008B [1]. The shade itself is older than the web: it matches ISCC-NBS block 219 (1955), and Maerz and Paul record a close name from 1925 [2]. Patriarch and Mardi Gras are near-duplicates, at CIEDE2000 distances of 2.4 and 1.1 [2]. The xkcd survey of 2010 uses a different dark magenta, #960056 [2].

Its closest named neighbor is [[purple]] [2]. The books say nothing more, so the origin of the name is undocumented.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Dark magenta is absent from museum paint. No painting in our archive of 23,781 covers at least 1% of its canvas with a close match [3]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole [3]. As a printed phrase, *dark magenta* appears from the 1860s, and peaks in the 2010s [4].
